book.name: Galatia
book.title: Kiristoos Yisa Tarjamonnante Kinin Yittsaa Bhawloos Galatia Eenana Kinin Thaapoono Warqanno

content: Kiristooska Haapadhayno Nathamono
Kiristoos worsho wonin dohorra woam kinin buloono natha wonin doadettsine. Ogonante wocchimbhayse woyee, tapir worsho maateebhode.
Marrato! Inta Bhawloos yena ida giye: Yesa qaamanam taxadhoadettsi yenin ee hamenna, Kiristoos hamin ko dahaannaar yena pootehe.
Qaama taxadhana ee hamayna wulna tapir yena ida giye: Musesa yiggin wulam toola yeam koda zaske.
Yedi yigginam toolintaka Barjo birante tipa maatana zagayna eena Kiristooskalanka edimayse Barjosa sunin imintora yedi pegadhidine.
Wodi Barjosa Manpasinka Barjodar woylamin qajintaka “Barjo yisa birante tipana eena woam kida maase” hamayse qaabe hayayse woda toole.
Harrna hambhidianna, Yesus Kiristooska wona pootayno Barjodar woylamin qajayse nashimmakkoka waadadhintane; qaama taxadhintabee taxadhima garintabe wona pootehe.
Ta koka yekka payyaka yivite ye dahade; ta keeda goninna yenin ee hamoamadettsi yeam maraa hayne?
Ogodettsino taysimeno yeam eelaa Barjokalankatehe.
“Likkono irshono taapan wulam koda ocche” hambhondettsine.
Yer waaniam hamin ko dahaakaar, yenin qaaboamadettsi inta Imbaa wontea Yesuska yedar woylamin inta qajidine. Yeam dhaddhisea hay ki hannaar, pirdinam yidar kida tiye.

Imbanaanato, inta ta koka yekka “Dhaqana qaamanam taxadha koda zaske” hamayse i giyna, ta koka yekka harrna i oytadhaa? Yin ko hanna, Kiristoossa masqalindar ziitadhayse diydinsa inin giyoono goa konin maatayno shidhidine.
Ta keeda yeam dhaddhisayna eena qaamaam taxadha bish dayma, buu ke maate ida zage.
Imbanaanato, nathamona ye eldhade. Nathamono yenno waan anngarmanam yenin thoosea hayeebhode; yin yenin hayerra kinka kinka nashimmakkoka kina waadadhee.
Harrna hambhidianna, “Een wulam hadettsi hayayse nashaa” hamea upsi kalaaka yiggino wul ko thoothade.
Ko dahaannaar kinka kiam kiam gavaynabee kiam itsaynabe ye hanna, kiam kiam yenin kaysoamadettsi mete yesaam gishee.
Manpasbee Waabe
Ta keeda inta yena ida giye: Manpasinka dehee; waansa anngarmanam hamin ko dahaakaar hayeebhode.
Harrna hambhidianna, waano Manpasindar, Manpasinoar waandar koda dhaabhe. Kinka kinka kiam kenin jibbenna, yenin zagenam hayana damattene.
Manpasin yeam entsendettsi ye yivina, yigginsa demente dahattene.
Waan waadimanoar dhesadhoonone; ogonoar sharmucimakko, minngamo, tagach,
aaninka ashkadhaana barjonana goodime, palpala haynta, jibbinta, palime, wooginta, waciminta, yibishiam nashinta, edime, kikalanka kashimayse kidar dhaabhinta,
eedi yeram anngardhinta, bardhinta, warsa, iginadettsinane. Birayse yena inin giyondettsi pir yena ida giye: Ogodettsin hayayna Barjosa bitamonam tiyehe.
Manpas Gazansa aapino nashimmakko, woza, payyamo, darshinta, lemmakko, eedina payya haynta, gonamo,
payya eedi maatinta, yisa metenam wottsintane. Iginadettsina yerraam marea yiggi qolehe.
Yesus Kiristoossa maataana eena waanam kosa qaabonbee anngarmanbesana kedi masqalindar ziitayse deesidine.
Barjosa Manpasinka dahaana wo hanna, ogo Manpasinka wo yaaye.
Kinka kinka kidar dhaabhintaka way woogimbheka sun wo erimabhoode.
